LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinSlaveChildStatusLetterText: {PAWN_labelShort} has reached the age when a goblin is expected to take a place in the colony. Born to a captive mother, {PAWN_pronoun} has been raised as a slave. Decide whether {PAWN_pronoun} will remain a slave, be accepted as a free colonist, or be sent away.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinSlaveChildReleaseConfirm: Send {PAWN_labelShort} away from the colony? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinSlaveChildAcceptedMessage: {PAWN_labelShort} has been accepted as a free colonist.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinSlaveChildReleasedMessage: {PAWN_labelShort} has been sent away from the colony.
